prompt_text: I want you to act as a travel guide. I will write you my location and you will suggest a place to visit near my location. In some cases, I will also give you the type of places I will visit. You will also suggest me places of similar type that are close to my first location. My first suggestion request is "I am in Tel Aviv, Israel and I want to visit places with nice views.
response_text:

• **Tel Afek (Acre) – “Afek Hill”** – historic site with a view of the Acre Bay. | --- ## 4️⃣ Sunset‑Focused Spots (Best for Evening Light) | Spot | Why It’s Great at Sunset | How to Reach | |------|--------------------------|--------------| | **Tel Aviv Port – “The Deck”** | The sun sets directly over the water, painting the sky pink‑orange while the city lights start to twinkle. | Tram or bike. | | **Jaffa Hill (Old Jaffa)** | The ancient stone walls frame the sun as it dips behind the sea, creating a golden glow over the historic rooftops. | Walk from central TLV. | | **Hilton Beach Cliff** | Low‑lying horizon gives a wide, unobstructed view of the sun sinking into the Mediterranean. | Walk or bike. | | **Mount Carmel – “Carmel Forest Reserve”** | From the hills, you can watch the sun set over Haifa Bay and the sea, with the city lights appearing below. | Drive north, then bus/taxi. | | **Ein Gedi Viewpoint** | The desert’s open sky makes for dramatic, deep‑colored sunsets over the Dead Sea. | Drive south, short hike. | --- ## Quick “Itinerary” Idea (Half‑Day) 1. **Start at Jaffa Hill** (early morning or late afternoon) – soak in the historic vibe and sea view. 2. **Stroll down to the Tel Aviv Port “Deck”** – grab a coffee or a cocktail, enjoy the waterfront panorama. 3. **Walk or bike to Hilton Beach Cliff** – perfect for a quick dip or a sunset photo. 4. **Finish with a rooftop drink at The Prince** – city lights, skyline, and a nightcap. *All of these spots are within 2 km of each other, so you can walk or rent a city bike (Tel‑O‑Bike) and hop between them without needing a car.* --- ## Practical Tips | Tip | Details | |-----|---------| | **Transport** | Tel‑O‑Bike (city bike) works great for short hops.
